text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a certain day off,
while attending a race as a spectator—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gooo! Go, go, go, right thereeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOAAAL!!
A magnificent, wire-to-wire breakaway victoryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAH!
Congrats~~! That was so movinggg~~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
Woah...! Amazing, amazing, amazing!
I'm so moved too~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right, right!? That feeling of 'I won't lose!'
just clashed like *KABOOOM*!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text: I see! That's why everyone is shining so brightly!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
So cool... I wanna try running too.
If only my legs were faster...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? If you wanna run, you can totally run!
You'll be fine, totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
No, everyone tells me 'it's impossible'.
Because in footraces, I'm always in dead last...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... Then, I'll give you a test!
A test to see if you can run in races in the future!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
A test...? 
Can I really pass it... even me...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whooo knooows~? It's a test, after all.
It's gonna be suuuuuu...per strict and really tough, you know?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What'll you do? Can you do your best?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, yeah! I'll do my best!
Because it's my dream...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
ALRIIIIIGHT! That's the spirit!
Then let's get started right away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
First, play tag with big sis!
Next, play on the park slides, and then have some snacks!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
...Wait, that's the "strict test"?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Never mind the details! Here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Tag, you're it! Next up is the slide!
Oh, let's buy some donuts from that shop too!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Donuts?
Waaah! I want a cream-filled one!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! That concludes the test.
The results of the test are—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Passed! Perfect score with a gold star flower!
You did a great job sticking it out till the end!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
Passed...! Yay... Yaaay!
I can run in races!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
But big sis...
That really wasn't a "strict test" at all, was it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! But even when I said it was "strict",
you answered that you'd do your best, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
As long as you have that desire to run, you'll be fine!
You'll deee~finitely reach your dream.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've been chasing my dream for a super long time too...
and even now, I'm still running in passionate races!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
Woah...! Yeah, I'll definitely become one!
A horse girl who shines brightly on the track!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go tell Mama too!
Thank you, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Keep at it! ...Ehehe, it felt like I was looking at my past self back there.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm totally fired up now! Time to go log some serious miles!
